text:
Landed on local main as merge 54797383 (branch commit f557679c) with follow-up d22f841e. Unpushed.
AC1: build.sbt:536 reads checkAll = ;compileAll;testAll;scalafmtCheckAll;scalafmtSbtCheck.
AC2: scratch/checkall-demo @ 7eb8691d (never lands) adds one failing proposition test carrying a formatting nit. The new alias reports 3x core Passed 231, then "Failed: Total 52, Failed 1", and scalafmt never runs. The old order (control) gives a scalafmt abort with 0 test totals. Excerpts and log digests are in the merge message.
AC3: the handoff section 5 trap note is rewritten. AGENTS.md names the alias only at line 162, without an order, so it is unchanged. Two further stale docs (the 2026-09-03 handoff and README.md) were fixed in d22f841e.
AC4: sbt githubWorkflowCheck exit 0. It is non-discriminating, since ci.yml does not call the alias.
Gate (LocallyObserved): clean checkAll on an export of exact f557679c. GATE_EXIT=0; 56 module/platform totals; 7,109 test executions (7,104 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed); scalafmt ran after the last test total. Main's delta since the gate base touches no build input.
Cold review (fresh context): every criterion met, and every number and digest re-verified against the logs. The two stale docs and the skipped-count wording were repaired in d22f841e.
Not established: the chain still stops at the first failing module/platform task. No independent reproduction.
